sentence: The room restates in the model's terms and its unused concepts show nothing the model lacks.

The room's organizing restates in the model's terms — a starter's second attempt and call for hands (R01, P01), coordinate templates and stray-pixel repair (P04, P05), the night-watch keeping the raute (P05, A03), defence against coverers with an appeal to stop (P05, P07, P09), spot choice and border talk with r/Ireland (P27, P08), and close-time thanks and celebration (P11, A07) — and none of the unused concepts shows organizing the model lacks or contradicts a standing element or arrow.
